title: phyllanthus juglandifolius subsp. cornifolius
intro: Phyllanthus juglandifolius subsp. cornifolius, commonly known as the 'corn-leaf chequered fruit', is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Phyllanthaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving liver function, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Phyllanthus juglandifolius subsp. cornifolius are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, and its therapeutic actions include hepatoprotective and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents in this plant may also have antimicrobial and antifungal properties, further highlighting its potential as a medicinal plant.
